description: Gmail channel adapter — OAuth 2.0 (installed-app flow) + Gmail REST API. Default path is pull-based: poll users.messages.list?q=is:unread, fetch each via users.messages.get, mark read after dispatch. send() encodes RFC 5322 and POSTs to users.messages.send. Push-based (Pub/Sub watch) is documented but not wired in MVP — see channels/gmail.env.example.
